content.name: llm-system-design
content.description: Use when designing, reviewing, or evolving an LLM product as a system. Trigger for prompt versus RAG versus agent versus adaptation decisions, model or provider routing, prompt and context architecture, token/cost/latency budgets, degradation and fallbacks, tenant isolation, and versioned LLM releases. Not for detailed retrieval, agent-loop, model-training, eval-harness, security-test, or GPU-runtime implementation.
